title: Northdale Clinic virtual triage onramp jot
content:
Meeting: Northdale Clinic — virtual triage kickoff (internal jot)
Date: 2025-11-02
Attendees: Dr. Aaron Bell (Northdale), Jenna Marshall (Nurse Manager), Samir Patel (IT), Maya Chen (Redwood SE), Luca Rinaldi (Redwood Solutions), Priya Desai (Redwood PM)

Purpose: capture constraints, quick wins, and a minimal POC plan for a virtual triage assistant integrating with Northdale's EHR. This is a working scratchpad — expect follow-ups and clarifications.

High-level ask from Northdale:
- Replace phone-only triage intake with chat-first (web + SMS) triage to reduce avg phone queue times and speed low-acuity routing.
- PHI safe: no external PHI leakage, audit logs for every request, ability to purge records on demand.
- Integrate with their EHR (Cerner) using FHIR endpoints for patient metadata and encounter creation.
- Targets: 80% of simple triage resolved without clinician handoff; 95th latency target < 350ms for generate-token path.

Constraints / environment notes:
- Network: clinic sits in Azure Canada Central; IT insists on VPC connection (private-deploy preferred) with outbound egress via allowlisted NAT. No inbound tunnels allowed.
- Data residency: patient data must remain in Canada; production must be in a Canada region or on-prem option.
- Auth/KMS: they use Azure Key Vault + HSM, want Redwood to support customer-managed keys for config secrets.
- Logging/telemetry: Audit trail required with redaction filters. Clinical ops can't see raw model prompts containing PHI in plaintext.
- Throughput: steady daytime traffic ~ 12 TPS, burst to 60 TPS on flu days. Concurrency per patient session needed (KV cache per-session).

Model/infra considerations we discussed:
- Start POC on a smaller instruction-tuned 7B that runs on quantized FP16/INT8 to hit latency SLOs; fallback path to 13B for difficult cases.
- Use Redwood caching (prefix + KV) to keep follow-on question latency low for active sessions.
- Token limits: initial context to include last 3 messages + structured triage form (~2k tokens). Confirm Cerner payload sizes (attachments will break this).
- Embeddings: use for patient symptom vectorization + recent encounter retrieval. Need to confirm retention policy for embedding-store (PHI rules).

Gotchas / risk items (callout):
1) PHI in prompts: clinic wants redaction but also wants explainability. Need approach: store redacted prompt in logs + hashed linkage to raw prompt stored encrypted under CMK available only to Northdale audit team. Confirm legal OK.
2) Cerner FHIR variants: their FHIR server uses custom profiles; mapping work required for Encounter/Condition resources. Plan a short mapping spike.
3) SMS channels: vendors sometimes truncate messages; triage flow must keep critical info within first 2 SMS segments.
4) HL7 attachments: if triage uploads images, our POC will not handle — treat as clinician escalation path.
5) Tokenization drift between model families — prompt templates need evaluation to avoid silent quality drops.

Immediate P0/P1 items (owners + target dates):
- P0: Network checklist for private deploy (Samir / Northdale IT) — list of allowed outbound endpoints & NAT IPs. (Ticket: INC-4821) — deadline 2025-11-07.
- P0: Data residency confirmation + signed DPA addendum consenting to Canadian-region hosting (Legal/Contracts) — Priya to coordinate — 2025-11-12.
- P0: Short spike: FHIR model mapping of Patient/Encounter/Observation with sample payloads (Luca) — deliverable: mapping doc + conversion scripts — 2025-11-09.
- P1: Redaction + secure raw-prompt storage design (Maya) — propose CMK flow and redaction pipeline — 2025-11-15.
- P1: Latency bench: run local quantized 7B perf tests with our Canada infra simulation (Infra) — target baseline numbers by 2025-11-10.

POC scope (minimal):
- Private deploy (VPC egress only) in Canada region, single availability zone for POC.
- UI: simple web chat + SMS via Twilio (Northdale already has Twilio acct).
- Features: symptom intake form -> model-generated triage decision (self-care / nurse follow-up / urgent) + automatic creation of Encounter resource in FHIR (draft).
- Logging: redacted prompt + encrypted raw stored in customer-side CMK.

Evaluation & success metrics (POC):
- Reduction in average time-to-first-response from 7 min to <2 min for low-acuity flows.
- Human escalation rate for low-acuity flows <20%.
- Model safety: zero high-risk hallucinations in 200 sample triage cases (manual review).
- Ops: No security exceptions in initial audit; ability to run dataset purge on-demand.

Open questions to resolve with Northdale:
- Do they require complete purge of all raw prompts or only export+delete? (Legal)
- Exact retention period for embeddings derived from PHI — retention = 0 ? encrypted at rest? (Privacy)
- Will SMS channel be used for PHI? If yes, must change to nurse-mediated SMS or avoid direct PHI content.
- What level of clinician explainability is required for automatic triage decisions? (simple rationale vs full prompt exposure)

Notes for follow-up call agenda (next week):
- Walk through network egress list + confirm NAT IPs (Samir)
- Show 7B perf numbers and expected fallbacks (Infra)
- Present redaction + CMK design (Maya) and get Legal thumbs up
- FHIR mapping walkthrough (Luca) with sample createEncounter flow
- Decide SMS policy and adjust UI flows accordingly

Quick prompts / testing ideas for POC:
- Few-shot prompt template with structured symptom checklist + age/comorbidities + last 3 messages.
- Use a conservative system prompt with explicit "do not hallucinate" and fallback utterances.
- Create a small eval set of 100 recent historical triage transcripts (sanitized) to run quality checks before live ramp.

Action log (short):
- 2025-11-02: Kickoff call held; Samir to email network spreadsheet.
- 2025-11-03: Priya filed DPA addendum request with Legal.
- 2025-11-04: Luca started FHIR mapping spike (shared sample payloads in CONFLUENCE).

Random scratch thoughts / ideas:
- Consider an "explainability bundle": short template explanation + link to clinician-only audit page where raw prompt can be unlocked by auditors.
- Cost optimization: aggressive session caching for active patients + reuse small-model in steady state, route to larger models only when confidence < threshold.

End of jot — keep this lean; convert to formal proposal after P0 checklist items are done.

-- Maya
